title: Orbit, with stations
summary: Header X's grammar with this layer's own band: every touch arrives on one line and enters an open ring at the signal taxonomy; a node rides past win/loss and resonance to the quarterly calibration, where the last 40° closes in red and the node comes home to start the next quarter.
story: Opens on the homepage's own words for this layer — the loop that learns — and draws the loop literally: four stations, one turn a quarter, closed only by the calibration. Its four stations are the four questions the next section lists.
copy: [K homepage job] h1 “The loop / that learns.” (retires “What gets measured compounds.” and its duplicate H2)
(FS) Facts · Engagement “Scoped at the readout” · Output “Signal Dashboard and Rebuild Sequence — yours”
[N] the ring's name “One quarter” (at its centre, replacing the diameter dimension); keyed-list glosses (what’s watched · why deals move · what lands · where the loop closes)
phone: ≤1023: callouts and the ring's name give way to the visible keyed list (kit). ≤767: the phone drawing (358×240) keeps the ring centred with a short tape of touches entering at 03.1, the four stations marked in 13px mono codes, and the red closing arc; the h1 wraps at 40px.

reference.site: Approved interior/X (header grammar) and the nav's ORBIT glyph (a line into an open ring with a node)
reference.borrowed: X's sheet: statement, facts ledger, the page's own shape drawn large in a registration frame with callouts and one dimension.
reference.kelwin: ORBIT in plan view with flat stations and drafting callouts (one flag, three horizontal leaders), a tape of touches on the entry line, a 40° gap that only the calibration closes. Deliberately not the accretion rings rejected in round 3 and not the homepage's iso slab 03.

motion: entrance: the kit head choreography; registration marks at 600–780ms; the tape of touches fades in and the entry line draws at 900ms; the ring plots clockwise from 03.1 (1.2s); the station nodes appear.

orchestrated moment (2.3–5.0s): a node rides the ring once from 03.1, each callout registering as it passes its station; at 03.4 the red arc closes the 40° gap (600ms) and the node rides it home to 03.1; then the ring's name, ‘One quarter’, fades in at its centre. No loop.
on the live site: plays once at 40% visible. Reduced motion: the closed ring with the node at 03.1, synchronously.
notes: 1,044px at 1440 (band 300 frame units; the 4-line lede is [K]). No dimension: a quarter is a lap, not a length, so the ring is named at its centre instead of measured across its diameter. One red beyond the label square and rule: the closing arc. No ambient loop on this page.
